overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: amended notices posted alongside date-stamped originals satisfied the requirement to record the original posting date and time. A minutes-timeliness allegation was withdrawn.

allegations.summary: Amended notices for the Aug 22, Sept 7, and Sept 14 meetings allegedly omitted the date and time the original notices were posted.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, the Board complied with this posting requirement because, by being posted with the original notices, the amended notices recorded the date and time the original notices were posted.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board failed to timely approve its meeting minutes; the complainant withdrew this allegation on November 30.
allegations.key_passage: On November 30, Mr. Higgins withdrew this allegation.
